proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure applied to the holding in any calendar year does not exceed 170 kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares.
display_label: Annual nitrogen limit from livestock manure
subject: occupier of a holding
rule: must ensure that total nitrogen in livestock manure applied does not exceed
object: 170 kg per hectare of the holding per calendar year
conditions: nitrogen applied whether directly by an animal or by spreading
evidence_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that, in any calendar year, the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure applied to the holding, whether directly by an animal or by spreading, does not exceed 170kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares.
reason: Core substantive obligation establishing the annual nitrogen limit per hectare from livestock manure.

proposition_text: The nitrogen limit in paragraph (1) does not apply where the occupier has been granted a derogation.
subject: occupier of a holding
rule: is exempt from paragraph (1) nitrogen limit
object: the 170 kg per hectare annual limit
conditions: occupier has been granted a derogation
evidence_text: Paragraph (1) does not apply where the occupier has been granted a derogation.
reason: Exception provision that disapplies the core nitrogen limit when a derogation is granted.

proposition_text: The amount of nitrogen for the purposes of this regulation is to be calculated in accordance with Schedule 1.
subject: amount of nitrogen
rule: is to be calculated in accordance with
conditions: for the purposes of this regulation
evidence_text: For the purposes of this regulation, the amount of nitrogen is to be calculated in accordance with Schedule 1.
reason: Cross-reference provision specifying the calculation methodology for nitrogen amounts.

proposition_text: In calculating the area of a holding for nitrogen spreading purposes, no account is to be taken of surface waters, hardstanding, buildings, roads or woodland (unless the woodland is used for grazing).
display_label: Exclusion of surface waters, hardstanding, buildings, roads and non-grazing woodland from holding area
subject: area of a holding
object: surface waters, hardstanding, buildings, roads or woodland (unless used for grazing)
conditions: for the purpose of ascertaining the amount of nitrogen permitted to be spread
exceptions: woodland used for grazing is included
evidence_text: any surface waters, hardstanding, buildings, roads or woodland (unless the woodland is used for grazing)
reason: Substantive rule defining which land types are excluded from the holding area calculation, with an exception for grazing woodland.

proposition_text: In calculating the area of a holding for nitrogen spreading purposes, no account is to be taken of land which is covered by a greenhouse for the whole of the year concerned.
display_label: Exclusion of year-round greenhouse land from holding area
subject: area of a holding
object: land covered by a greenhouse for the whole year
conditions: for the purpose of ascertaining the amount of nitrogen permitted to be spread
greenhouse covers the land for the whole of the year concerned
temporal_condition: for the whole of the year concerned
evidence_text: any land which is covered by a greenhouse for the whole of the year concerned
reason: Distinct substantive rule excluding year-round greenhouse land from the holding area calculation.
